ROS 2 — самый распространённый открытый: ROS 2 is the most widely used open-source software framework for robots. Nav2 is its standard navigation stack: localization, path planning, obstacle avoidance.
адаптивный фильтр частиц: по умолчанию о: adaptive particle filter: 500 to 2,000 particles by default
волновой алгоритм Дейкстры по карте стои: wavefront Dijkstra over a cost map
ведёт робота по пути и объезжает препятс: drives the robot along the path and around obstacles
Стандартный навигационный стек ROS 2 в ш: With default settings the standard ROS 2 navigation stack uses no neural networks: a particle filter localizes the robot, and Dijkstra finds the path (use_astar: false). For a warehouse or an office with a ready map, this is often enough. Documentation: docs.nav2.org.
SLAM по видео с одной камеры: строит кар: SLAM from single-camera video: it builds a map and the camera's trajectory. A neural network helps find the same points in neighboring frames.
поправки соответствий между кадрами и их: updates to frame-to-frame correspondences and their confidence
шаг Гаусса — Ньютона по позам камеры и г: a Gauss–Newton step over camera poses and depths
Сеть находит соответствия, геометрию счи: The network finds correspondences; classical optimization computes the geometry. Without global optimization the average trajectory error on the EuRoC dataset is 0.186 m instead of 0.022 m (Teed, Deng, NeurIPS 2021). MASt3R-SLAM (CVPR 2025) and VGGT-SLAM (2025) follow a similar scheme.
Оценка пути по одному IMU, без камер: на: Trajectory estimation from an IMU alone, without cameras: for example, for a person wearing the sensor in glasses or a helmet. A neural network estimates the displacement over a short time window, and a Kalman filter fuses the estimates.
смещение за окно времени и его неуверенн: displacement over the time window and its uncertainty
Сеть выдаёт измерение вместе с неуверенн: The network outputs a measurement together with its uncertainty, and a Kalman filter fuses it with the motion model (Liu et al., 2020). In AI-IMU a network tunes the filter's noise Q and R on the fly; in KalmanNet it learns the filter's gain. The model and the "predict → correct" steps stay classical.
Навигационные модели из Беркли: ведут ро: Navigation models from Berkeley: using camera frames, they guide a robot to a place shown in a photo and explore unfamiliar buildings.
узлы — места, рёбра — проходы; поиск пут: nodes are places, edges are passages; path search on the graph
действия до следующего узла; у NoMaD — д: actions to the next node; diffusion-based in NoMaD
Навигационные модели, обученные на данны: Navigation models trained on data from many robots keep a graph of places on long routes and search it for a path: in ViNT this is A* (Shah et al., CoRL 2023), in NoMaD graph search plus frontier exploration (Sridhar et al., ICRA 2024).
Робот Google DeepMind, который водит по: A Google DeepMind robot that guides people around a building when asked in plain words, for example "Where can I return this?". It knows the building from a recorded walkthrough, a video tour.
запись обхода здания и просьба словами и: a recorded walkthrough of the building and a request in words or as a picture
выбирает кадр тура, где цель: picks the tour frame that shows the goal
положения кадров тура восстанавливает пр: COLMAP recovers the positions of the tour frames; the robot finds its own place by matching points against the frames
путь по графу и его исполнение: a path on the graph and its execution
Google DeepMind, CoRL 2024: большая моде: Google DeepMind, CoRL 2024: a large model understands the request and picks the goal, and everything else is classical navigation.
Нейросетевой планировщик движений руки:: A neural motion planner for an arm: it proposes a trajectory around obstacles right away instead of a long search.
выбирает траекторию, где меньше всего то: picks the trajectory with the fewest points inside the robot
Сеть научили повторять классический план: The network was trained to imitate the classical AIT* planner on many scenes generated in simulation. In experiments on a real robot the success rate is 66.7% without the final check and 95.8% with it (Dalal et al., IROS 2025).
Планировщик беспилотного автомобиля на п: A rule-based planner for self-driving cars. Learned planners were compared against it in the nuPlan challenge.
модель следования за машиной впереди; 15: a car-following model; 15 combinations of lateral offset and speed
симуляция каждого варианта, выбор лучшег: simulates each variant, picks the best, brakes in an emergency
В соревновании nuPlan простой планировщи: In the nuPlan challenge a simple rule-based planner scored 92–93 points in closed loop, the best learned one 72–73 (Dauner et al., CoRL 2023). The top places went to hybrids: the forecast is learned, and rules check the decision. The learned Diffusion Planner (ICLR 2025) beat PDM-Closed on hard scenes, but on the main benchmark only together with rule-based refinement.
Слить IMU и GPS дрона сотни раз в секунд: Fuse a drone's IMU and GPS hundreds of times a second
Одна гипотеза, почти линейная модель, вы: One hypothesis, a nearly linear model, a high rate: a classic job for the EKF.
Следить за мячом, пока он на миг скрылся: Track a ball while it briefly disappears behind a leg

Глобальная локализация: гипотез много, о: Global localization: there are many hypotheses, and a single Kalman bell curve can't hold them.

Карты нет — её строят на ходу вместе с п: There is no map: it is built on the go, together with the pose.
Шлем VR следит за головой по камерам и I: A VR headset tracks the head with cameras and an IMU

Маршрут пылесоса по готовой карте кварти: A robot vacuum's route on a ready map of the apartment
Две-три степени свободы и известная карт: Two or three degrees of freedom and a known map: a grid and A* are more than enough.
Рука с 7 суставами тянется между полками: A 7-joint arm reaches between cabinet shelves
Семь степеней свободы: сетка не помещает: Seven degrees of freedom: a grid doesn't fit in memory, so random sampling does the job.
Понять по камере, что пол мокрый и по не: Tell from the camera that the floor is wet and unsafe to drive on
Какой пол мокрый, формулой не задать: ну: No formula defines which floor is wet: you need a model trained on examples.
Ткань не описать простой моделью, и сост: Fabric can't be described by a simple model, and the state of a T-shirt doesn't boil down to a few numbers. The Part 1 lessons take this on.
Классика хороша, когда мир можно описать: The classics are good when the world can be described: the motion model, noise, the map, obstacles. What counts as a wet floor and how fabric lies can't be captured by a formula. That calls for data, and this is where Part 1 of the course begins.
Q и R в фильтре Калмана — паспортные хар: Are Q and R in a Kalman filter just sensor datasheet values that need no tuning?
Да, их берут из паспорта: Yes, they come from the datasheet
R близок к паспорту датчика, а Q прячет: R is close to the sensor's datasheet value, but Q hides everything the model doesn't know, so it is chosen with a margin
Их всегда учат нейросетью: They are always learned by a neural network
В лаборатории колёса шумели на 0,6 см за: In the lab the wheels had 0.6 cm of noise per step, yet with a model σ of 1 cm the truth left the band during the rangefinder dropout. 2 cm did the job: Q also has to cover the wheel scale error and slip.
Фильтр Калмана работает только с гауссов: Does the Kalman filter work only with Gaussian noise?
Нет: среди линейных оценок он лучший при: No: among linear estimators it is the best for any noise with known variances, and with Gaussian noise it is the best overall
Нет, шум ему вообще не важен: No, noise doesn't matter to it at all
Гауссовость нужна для оптимальности сред: Gaussian noise is needed for optimality among all estimators, not for the filter to work. It gets worse when the distribution is multimodal, as for Ada waking up in one of two identical bedrooms: then a single bell curve lies.
Фильтр частиц сам найдёт робота, если то: Will a particle filter find the robot by itself if the robot has been carried to another place?
Да, частицы для этого и нужны: Yes, that's what particles are for
Только если в фильтр подмешивают случайн: Only if random particles are injected into the filter: there are no particles near the new place
Да, если частиц больше тысячи: Yes, if there are more than a thousand particles
Пересэмплирование размножает только те г: Resampling only multiplies the hypotheses that already exist. In the lab, without injection the filter was off by 2.7 m after 10 seconds; with injection it found Ada in 1.25 s.
Чем больше частиц, тем фильтр всегда луч: Is a filter with more particles always better?
Точнее, но дороже, и от неоднозначности: More accurate but more expensive, and more particles don't save it from ambiguity or a kidnapping
Нет, больше 100 частиц не нужно: No, you never need more than 100 particles
Каждая частица — это расчёт ожидаемого с: Every particle means computing an expected scan. That's why the number of particles is adapted on the fly (KLD-sampling): many while the cloud is wide, few once it has gathered.
Чтобы построить карту, достаточно хороше: Is a good lidar enough to build a map?
Да, лидар сам даёт карту: Yes, the lidar gives you the map by itself
Нет: каждый скан надо положить на карту: No: each scan has to be placed on the map from the correct pose, otherwise the walls double
Нет, нужна ещё камера: No, you also need a camera
В лаборатории увод одометрии на 1° за ме: In the lab an odometry heading drift of 1° per meter doubled the walls and closed the kitchen door. That's why the pose and the map are estimated together, and that is SLAM.
A* всегда раскрывает гораздо меньше верш: Does A* always expand far fewer nodes than Dijkstra?
Обычно, но в ловушках и тупиках почти ст: Usually, but in traps and dead ends almost as many; with a zero heuristic it simply is Dijkstra
В лаборатории на пустом пути A* раскрыл: In the lab, on an open path A* expanded 24 cells versus 314, and with a trap 160 versus 332.
A* с любой эвристикой находит кратчайший: Does A* find the shortest path with any heuristic?
Только с допустимой эвристикой, которая: Only with an admissible heuristic, one that never overestimates the remaining path
Взвешенный A* с ε > 1 переоценивает оста: Weighted A* with ε > 1 overestimates the remainder: it expands fewer nodes, and the path can be longer, but by no more than a factor of ε.
RRT, если дать ему больше времени, найдё: Given more time, will RRT find the shortest path?
Да, со временем любой путь выпрямится: Yes, any path straightens out over time
Нет: RRT почти наверняка сходится к неоп: No: RRT almost surely converges to a suboptimal path; RRT* gives the shortest one
Нет, RRT вообще не гарантирует, что найд: No, RRT doesn't even guarantee that it will find a path
Это доказали Karaman и Frazzoli в 2011 г: Karaman and Frazzoli proved this in 2011. In the lab the RRT path stayed 18% longer than the shortest, while RRT* got within 1% of it. Still, RRT finds a path with probability tending to one; it's just that in a narrow passage this can take thousands of iterations.

Средняя ошибка: дальномер ${cm(r.raw)},: Average error: rangefinder ${cm(r.raw)}, complementary filter ${cm(r.comp)}, Kalman ${cm(r.kf)}. The Kalman filter chose by itself how much to trust the measurement: by the end K = ${fmtF(r.Kend, 3)}, so each measurement moves the estimate by about a tenth of the discrepancy. We gave the complementary filter α = 0.98 from lesson 0.2, and a measurement moves it by only 2%. The wheels overestimate the distance by 4%, and this error has no time to fade. With α = 0.9 it would give ${cm(E4.KF.run({ alpha: 0.9 }).m.comp.rmse)}, like the Kalman filter: 1 − K is exactly the best α. But the Kalman filter computes this weight from the noise levels Q and R, and those are set by the engineer. What happens if they are set wrong?
Подбери шумы Q и R: Tune the noise Q and R
Фильтру задали неверные шумы: σ модели 1: The filter has been given the wrong noise levels: model σ 10 cm, rangefinder σ 2 cm. It thinks the rangefinder is more accurate than the wheels, trusts every measurement and jitters along with it, and the uncertainty band doesn't match the real error. Tune the noise so that the estimate is accurate and the ±2σ band is calibrated: the true position is almost always inside, and the band is no wider than needed.
Истина внутри полосы ±2σ не меньше 90 %: Truth inside the ±2σ band at least 90% of the time
Полоса в среднем не шире ±9 см: Average band no wider than ±9 cm
σ дальномера известна: измерения гуляют: The rangefinder σ is known: measurements wander by about 10 cm. The model σ is how much the wheels err in one 0.1 s step. That's a fraction of a centimeter, but it's better to leave a margin.
σ модели ${cm(s.sq)}, σ дальномера ${cm(: Model σ ${cm(s.sq)}, rangefinder σ ${cm(s.sr)}: error ${cm(s.kf)}, truth inside the band ${fmt1(s.cover * 100, 0)}% of the time, band ±${cm(s.band)}. Try a model σ of 2 cm and a rangefinder σ of 20 cm: the error is almost the same, because the estimate depends only on the ratio of Q to R. But the band gets wider than needed. The ratio of the noise levels determines the estimate, and their size determines how well the uncertainty is calibrated.
Шумы подобраны, но проверены только на п: The noise is tuned, but it has only been tested on a run where measurements arrive reliably. Now, halfway along, the rangefinder loses the wall for 3 seconds: Ada passes an open door, and all that time the filter can rely only on the wheels. We keep the rangefinder σ at 10 cm, so one knob is left: the model σ. Tune it so that the true position stays inside the ±2σ band for the whole dropout.

Пока измерений нет, дисперсия растёт на: While there are no measurements, the variance grows by Q every step. If it grows more slowly than the real wheel error accumulates, the filter is overconfident.
Пока дальномер молчал, полоса выросла с: While the rangefinder was silent, the band grew from ±${cm(r.b1)} to ±${cm(r.b2)}, and with the first measurements it narrowed again to ±${cm(r.b3)}: K jumped, and the filter quickly returned to the rangefinder. After the dropout the complementary filter was off by up to ${cm(r.afterComp)}, the Kalman filter by up to ${cm(r.afterKf)}. Q hides everything the model doesn't know: the wheel scale error, slip. That's why Q is chosen with a margin and the band's calibration is checked.
